001package org.clafer.compiler;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005import java.util.Map;
006import java.util.Map.Entry;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.Model;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.Solver;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.BoolVar;
010import org.clafer.assertion.Assertion;
011import org.clafer.choco.constraint.Constraints;
012import org.clafer.collection.Either;
013import org.clafer.common.Check;
014import org.clafer.instance.InstanceModel;
015
016/**
017 *
018 * @author jimmy
019 */
020public class ClaferAsserter implements ClaferSearch {
021
022    private final Solver solver;
023    private final ClaferSolutionMap solutionMap;
024    private final Map<Assertion, Either<Boolean, BoolVar>> assertions;
025    private int count = 0;
026    private boolean more = true;
027
028    public ClaferAsserter(Solver solver, ClaferSolutionMap solutionMap, Map<Assertion, Either<Boolean, BoolVar>> assertions) {
029        this.solver = Check.notNull(solver);
030        this.solutionMap = Check.notNull(solutionMap);
031        this.assertions = Check.notNull(assertions);
032    }
033
034    public ClaferAsserter() {
035        Model model = new Model();
036        this.solver = model.getSolver();
037        this.solutionMap = null;
038        this.assertions = null;
039        this.more = false;
040    }
041
042    @Override
043    public boolean find() {
044        if (!more) {
045            return false;
046        }
047        more &= count == 0 ? solveFirst() : solveNext();
048        if (solver.isStopCriterionMet()) {
049            more = false;
050            throw new ReachedLimitException();
051        }
052        if (more) {
053            count++;
054        }
055        return more;
056    }
057
058    private boolean solveFirst() {
059        List<BoolVar> boolVars = new ArrayList<>(assertions.size());
060        for (Either<?, BoolVar> assertion : assertions.values()) {
061            if (assertion.isLeft() && assertion.getLeft().equals(Boolean.TRUE)) {
062                return solver.solve();
063            } else if (assertion.isRight()) {
064                boolVars.add(assertion.getRight());
065            }
066        }
067        if (boolVars.isEmpty()) {
068            return false;
069        }
070        Constraints.or(boolVars.toArray(new BoolVar[boolVars.size()])).post();
071        return solver.solve();
072    }
073
074    private boolean solveNext() {
075        List<BoolVar> boolVars = new ArrayList<>(assertions.size());
076        for (Either<?, BoolVar> assertion : assertions.values()) {
077            if (assertion.isRight()) {
078                BoolVar boolVar = assertion.getRight();
079                if (boolVar.isInstantiatedTo(0)) {
080                    boolVars.add(boolVar);
081                }
082            }
083        }
084        if (boolVars.isEmpty()) {
085            return false;
086        }
087        Constraints.or(boolVars.toArray(new BoolVar[boolVars.size()])).post();
088        return solver.solve();
089    }
090
091    public Assertion[] failedAssertions() {
092        if (count == 0 || !more) {
093            throw new IllegalStateException("No instances. Did you forget to call find?");
094        }
095        List<Assertion> failedAssertions = new ArrayList<>(assertions.size());
096        for (Entry<Assertion, Either<Boolean, BoolVar>> assertion : assertions.entrySet()) {
097            Either<Boolean, BoolVar> value = assertion.getValue();
098            if (value.isLeft() && value.getLeft().equals(Boolean.TRUE)) {
099                failedAssertions.add(assertion.getKey());
100            } else if (value.isRight() && value.getRight().getValue() == 1) {
101                failedAssertions.add(assertion.getKey());
102            }
103        }
104        return failedAssertions.toArray(new Assertion[failedAssertions.size()]);
105    }
106
107    @Override
108    public InstanceModel instance() {
109        if (count == 0 || !more) {
110            throw new IllegalStateException("No instances. Did you forget to call find?");
111        }
112        return solutionMap.getInstance();
113    }
114
115    @Override
116    public int instanceCount() {
117        return count;
118    }
119
120    @Override
121    public Solver getInternalSolver() {
122        return solver;
123    }
124}
